name: Instagram Feed
summary: Passive finite media collection with optional account context, native list and figure semantics, explicit destinations, and target-owned records.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native thematic section when a visible heading can name it; otherwise a generic div. Omitted when no valid items exist.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional heading and valid paired account-link region.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading whose target-unique id names the section root.

anatomy.name: handle
anatomy.description: Optional native account-profile link rendered only when both label and destination are non-empty.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Native unordered finite collection of valid target-owned media records in source order.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item; passive unless it contains a real native destination.

anatomy.name: itemLink
anatomy.description: Optional native anchor wrapping one figure when the target supplies a real item destination.

anatomy.name: figure
anatomy.description: Native figure grouping one valid media record and its optional authored caption.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Target-owned informative or decorative media with explicit alternative-text semantics.

anatomy.name: caption
anatomy.description: Optional always-visible authored figcaption; provider metrics are not canonical fields.

states.name: handleFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the optional account link.

states.name: itemLinkFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on an item-wide native destination.

behavior.name: conditionalRoot
behavior.description: A non-empty visible heading creates and names a native thematic section through a target-unique id; without a heading targets use a generic div rather than an unnamed landmark.

behavior.name: requiredItems
behavior.description: Missing or empty required valid media records omit the complete component instead of rendering an empty shell.

behavior.name: pairedHandle
behavior.description: The optional account handle renders only when both a non-empty visible label and a real target-owned destination exist; targets never synthesize # or preview-only URLs.

behavior.name: finiteNativeCollection
behavior.description: Targets preserve native ul, li, figure, and optional figcaption semantics for a finite already-rendered collection; S16 does not implement the APG dynamic feed pattern, article focus movement, busy state, or infinite loading.

behavior.name: itemNavigationBoundary
behavior.description: Passive records remain unfocusable. Targets use native links or buttons only for real destinations or actions, avoid nested interaction inside an item-wide link, and preserve accessible names, history, activation, and visible focus.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, localized, RTL, unbroken, zoomed, captioned, uncaptioned, passive, and linked records remain in authored order and within the available component container without viewport-specific markup.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: S16 owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, event, listener, observer, request, provider SDK, timer, layout read, authored motion, custom element, hydration, asset, or neutral runtime. Provider authorization, fetching, caching, consent, freshness, failures, moderation, analytics, ordering, and metric truth remain target-owned.

properties.name: heading
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the heading and render a generic root without aria-labelledby.
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; targets choose its native heading rank and unique id.

properties.name: handle
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete handle link when the label or paired destination is empty.
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible account label paired with handleDestination.

properties.name: handleDestination
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete handle link when the destination or paired label is empty; never invent a fallback.
properties.description: Optional target-owned native profile destination paired with handle.

properties.name: items
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete component when no valid media item is supplied.
properties.description: Required ordered target-owned native item, figure, media, optional caption, and optional destination compositions.

properties.name: action
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the action region without reserving layout space.
properties.description: Optional target-owned native account or gallery action; targets may compose the canonical Button or Link contract.

accessibility: Render a native section only when a non-empty visible contextual heading can name it; otherwise use a generic div and omit the complete root when no valid media records exist.
Preserve native ul, li, figure, optional figcaption, image, and anchor semantics; do not apply the APG dynamic feed pattern to this finite already-rendered collection.

Provide useful alternatives for informative imagery, empty alternatives for explicitly decorative media, and visible authored captions without depending on hover, focus, touch, color, provider metrics, or motion.

Keep passive records out of the tab order. Only real handle, item, or action destinations receive native semantics, accessible names, activation, history, full pointer targets, and visible keyboard focus.

Keep content contained through narrow widths, localization, RTL, zoom, 200 percent text, forced colors, dark themes, mixed captions, and unbroken strings without alternate DOM or component JavaScript.
Targets communicate provider loading, empty, failure, consent, stale, moderation, and data-truth states as accessible content outside the neutral component.

shopify.notes: Maps localized optional heading and paired account/action links plus validated merchant image blocks to canonical classes with strict empty omission and zero component JavaScript.
